monthly_cost_basis.note: A Glue DPU-minutes estimate with a 10-minute per-run minimum, never measured spend.

measurement.lines_ingested_24h: rows_written on the Glue job's load_metrics rows in the selected window, counted only where the job confirmed the target write — every source type; runs that stopped before Glue, and runs from before the job recorded counts, contribute nothing
measurement.processing_rate: that same rows-loaded count ÷ wall-clock hours in the selected window — an average over the window, not the speed of any one run
measurement.overall_success_rate: AWS/States ExecutionsSucceeded ÷ (Succeeded + Failed + Aborted + TimedOut) (Sum), with the runs rejected at approval taken out of Failed — a reviewer's rejection is not a failure. If the rejections could not be read, nothing is taken out
measurement.failed_pipelines: AWS/States ExecutionsFailed (Sum), less the runs rejected at approval — failed executions, not distinct pipelines. An approval nobody answered in time still counts as failed
measurement.rejected_at_approval: pipeline_failure records in the selected window whose error_name is ApprovalRejected — runs a reviewer rejected at an approval gate. Not counted in Failed Executions or the Success Rate
measurement.monthly_cost: AgenticDataIngestion/Pipeline GlueJob.RunCostEstimate (Sum over the selected window) — a Glue DPU-minutes estimate with a 10-minute per-run minimum, never measured spend
